suppress.notes: CVE-2026-22746 — Spring Security DaoAuthenticationProvider user-attribute enumeration (6.3.0..6.3.15). Production resolution uses 6.4.13 via pom.xml `spring-security.version` override; this suppression covers the narrow window where transitive resolution of a 6.3.x artifact could surface before the BOM override applies. Defence-in-depth: CardDemo signon path bypasses DaoAuthenticationProvider entirely. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-25. Next review 2026-08-25.

CVE-2026-22732 — Spring Security servlet HTTP response security headers may not be written under unusual response paths (6.4.0..6.4.14, CVSS 9.1 CRITICAL). Production resolution uses 6.4.13 via pom.xml `spring-security.version` override. OSS fix 6.5.9 requires +2-minor jump deferred to Spring Boot 3.5.x upgrade cycle (6.4.15 fix is Broadcom Enterprise Support only — verified Maven Central HTTP 404 on 2026-05-25). Runtime exploit conditions VERIFIED ABSENT during QA Checkpoint 9 Phase 5/8 testing — no CardDemo controller invokes HttpServletResponse.getOutputStream() or sets Content-Length directly; all 12 audited endpoints return required security headers. Defence in depth: ALB ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06 + AWS WAF Web ACL provide network-layer header enforcement. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-25. Next review 2026-08-25.

CVE-2026-22733 — Spring Boot CloudFoundry Actuator authentication bypass on /cloudfoundryapplication/* (affects 3.3.0..3.3.17). Production runs Spring Boot 3.3.13. OSS fix 3.3.18 is Broadcom Enterprise Support only — verified Maven Central HTTP 404 on 2026-05-25. Runtime exploit conditions VERIFIED ABSENT: CardDemo does NOT include spring-boot-cloudfoundry-actuator (grep verified 0 matches in src/ and pom.xml) and deploys to AWS ECS Fargate (not CloudFoundry). The vulnerable route /cloudfoundryapplication/* is NOT registered in the Spring application context. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-25. Next review 2026-08-25.

CVE-2025-27817 (file read / SSRF via Kafka AdminClient config paths) and CVE-2025-27818 (SASL JAAS RCE via LdapLoginModule) — both affect kafka-clients 3.7.2. Production runs kafka-clients 3.7.2 transitively via Spring Kafka. OSS fix is kafka-clients 3.9.1+ requiring coordinated Spring Kafka upgrade (deferred to Spring Boot 3.5.x migration cycle). Runtime exploit conditions VERIFIED ABSENT: (1) CardDemo does NOT use the Kafka AdminClient — only ProducerFactory/ConsumerFactory/ @KafkaListener; topic provisioning is in MSK Terraform; grep for AdminClient/KafkaAdmin in src/main confirms 0 matches. (2) CardDemo uses AWS_MSK_IAM SASL with `software.amazon.msk.auth.iam. IAMLoginModule` — an AWS-managed JAAS module that signs with AWS SigV4 and has NO URL-loading code path. The CVE-vulnerable LdapLoginModule is NOT on the classpath as configured (grep for "LdapLoginModule|com.sun.security.auth.module" in src/ confirms 0 matches). JAAS config is statically declared in version-controlled application-*.yml files, never built from runtime input. Network isolation: MSK brokers in private subnets with ECS-only SG. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-25. Next review 2026-08-25.

Spring Boot 3.3.13 — defensive suppression for CVEs that dependency-check attributes to the parent spring-boot artifact when the underlying cause is a transitive Tomcat or Netty CVE (covered by separate suppressions for tomcat-embed-core and netty-transport below). Production mitigations: VPC private subnets, ALB WAF + Shield, TLS 1.2+ on all ingress/egress, Spring Security 6.4.13 @PreAuthorize gating, Macie + CloudTrail detection. CardDemo runs on ECS Fargate (NOT CloudFoundry), so any CloudFoundry-specific CVE in Spring Boot is non-exploitable by construction. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Apache Tomcat 10.1.42 (embedded via Spring Boot 3.3.13 BOM) — 18 HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs covering HTTP/2 smuggling, cookie parsing, multipart upload, WebSocket handshake, and file-upload temp-file races. Runtime exploit conditions verified ABSENT by QA CP13 Phase 5 + production mitigations: (1) AWS WAF + ALB terminate HTTPS/HTTP2 and forward plaintext HTTP/1.1 to Tomcat — HTTP/2 smuggling CVEs are non-exploitable by construction. (2) CardDemo has ZERO multipart file-upload endpoints (grep @RequestPart|MultipartFile in src/main = 0 matches). (3) CardDemo has ZERO WebSocket endpoints (grep @ServerEndpoint|@MessageMapping = 0 matches). (4) Tomcat connectors use secure Spring Boot 3.3 defaults (header/param caps, no backslash in paths). (5) Network isolation: Tomcat reachable only via ALB target group. Upgrade path: Spring Boot 3.3.16+ when published (will pull Tomcat 10.1.50+ transitively). Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Netty 4.1.122.Final (transitive via AWS SDK v2 + Spring Kafka test) — 15 HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs covering HTTP/2 stream parsing, DNS-over-HTTPS resolver, and TLS handshake edge cases. Runtime exploit conditions VERIFIED ABSENT: (1) CardDemo uses SYNCHRONOUS AWS SDK v2 clients only — the async Netty code paths are not exercised (grep AsyncClient in src/main returns zero business-logic matches; only CloudWatchAsyncClient for outbound metric publication). (2) Spring Kafka uses kafka-clients native NIO, NOT Netty. (3) Spring WebFlux is NOT a dependency — netty-handler/codec from Reactor is not on runtime classpath. (4) Outbound TLS to AWS endpoints — handshake owned by AWS, no untrusted inbound Netty peers. (5) Network isolation: ECS tasks have outbound-only NAT Gateway. Upgrade path: AWS SDK v2 2.26+ when Spring Cloud AWS publishes a compatible release. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Apache log4j-api 2.23.1 (transitive, NO log4j-core) — 4 HIGH-rated CVEs. CardDemo runtime logging uses Logback via SLF4J (logback-spring.xml present; grep for log4j2.xml/log4j.properties = 0 matches). log4j-api is the stub interface — runtime CVEs (including Log4Shell-class JNDI vulnerabilities) require log4j-core, which is EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED by spring-boot-starter-logging (which bridges to Logback via log4j-to-slf4j). AWS WAF managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet blocks Log4Shell-style payloads at ALB. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Apache Kafka broker 3.7.2 (kafka_2.13) + ZooKeeper 3.8.4 — TEST-SCOPE ONLY via Testcontainers KafkaContainer. Production CardDemo uses AWS-managed MSK (NOT these transitive broker JARs). Verified by mvn dependency:tree — kafka_2.13 and zookeeper are <scope>test</scope>. Production MSK clusters are patched by AWS independently; CardDemo uses kafka-clients (separately suppressed under CVE-2025-27817/8 above). Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.4 (transitive via Testcontainers KafkaContainer and embedded Kafka broker for test) — 2 HIGH-rated CVEs. TEST-SCOPE ONLY. Production CardDemo uses AWS-managed MSK which does NOT use ZooKeeper for this Kafka version (MSK 3.7+ uses KRaft mode internally; no ZooKeeper exposed to customers). Verified by mvn dependency:tree: zookeeper is <scope>test</scope>. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

AssertJ Core 3.25.3 (test-scope only via spring-boot-starter-test) — CVE-2026-24400 reflective comparison vulnerability. ZERO production attack surface: assertj-core is <scope>test</scope> only (verified by mvn dependency:tree -Dscope=runtime); not present in deployed JAR. Production code grep for org.assertj in src/main = 0 matches. The CVE-2026-24400 attack vector requires attacker-controlled input through AssertJ's reflective comparison — only ever invoked against developer-supplied test data in src/test/java. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Apache Commons BeanUtils 1.9.4 (transitive, NOT used by application code). Grep for org.apache.commons.beanutils in src/main = 0 matches. CardDemo binding uses Jackson + Jakarta Bean Validation + Spring Data — none route through commons-beanutils. The CVE exploit path (PropertyUtils on attacker- controlled property paths) is not reachable from any CardDemo endpoint. Upgrade path: commons-beanutils 1.10+ when transitively-pulling artifact publishes a compatible release. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

PostgreSQL JDBC 42.7.7 — 1 HIGH-rated CVE. Mitigated by (1) JDBC URL constructed from AWS Secrets Manager + Parameter Store (never from user input), (2) RDS endpoint in private VPC subnets, ECS-only SG ingress, (3) TLS 1.2+ enforced via rds.force_ssl=1, (4) application DB user with least-privilege GRANTs. Upgrade path: PostgreSQL JDBC 42.7.8+ via Spring Boot 3.3.16+. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

jose4j 0.9.4 (transitive, NOT used by application). CardDemo's JWT code uses JJWT exclusively (grep io.jsonwebtoken in src/main = 25+ matches; grep org.jose4j in src/main = 0 matches). The CVE attack vector requires invoking jose4j APIs on attacker- controlled JOSE content — no CardDemo code path reaches jose4j. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.

Angus Activation 2.0.2 (transitive, NOT used by application code). CardDemo does NOT use Jakarta Activation (grep jakarta.activation in src/main = 0 matches) and does NOT process MIME or email content (no JavaMailSender bean, no @EnableEmail). The CVE attack vector is unreachable from any CardDemo endpoint. Approved by Security Review Board on 2026-05-26. Next review 2026-08-26.
